name: Shokusou! Mahou Shoujo Hikaru
source:
Maki George, the younger brother of the leader of Nemesis, a secret organization bent on world domination, betrays his brother and the organization for justice. Nemesis uses human-monster hybrids for their operations. George steals an Injel, a magical creature that can transform humans, though it carries risks: men can lose their sanity and women without special compatibility become puppets of Nemesis.

George seeks a compatible girl to use the Injel and fight Nemesis. Guided by the Injel, he arrives at St. Eijo Girls' Academy, hoping to find such a girl but fearing he will drag an innocent into danger. When Nemesis attacks the academy, George uses the Injel to protect the girls but nearly loses control. Yuuki Hikaru, a student, transforms with the Injel, revealing her compatibility and defeating the monster.

George explains to Hikaru that the monsters are linked to a series of abductions and assaults at the academy, targeting girls compatible with the Injel. Angered by her friend's victimization, Hikaru decides to fight as a magical girl. George, with nowhere to go, is taken in by Hikaru and her mother, Yuuki Asuka, starting their cohabitation and battle against Nemesis.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100609173523/http://www.lilith-soft.com/black/product44.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
Maki George是一心统治世界的秘密组织Nemesis领导人的弟弟，为了正义而背叛了他的兄弟和该组织。复仇女神使用人类与怪物的混合体进行行动。乔治偷走了引吉勒，这是一种可以改变人类的神奇生物，尽管它也存在风险：男人可能会失去理智，而没有特殊兼容性的女人会成为涅墨西斯的傀儡。

乔治寻找一位兼容的女孩来使用引支勒并对抗涅墨西斯。在引支勒的指引下，他来到了圣英珠女子学院，希望能找到这样一个女孩，但又担心自己会把一个无辜的人拖入危险之中。当涅墨西斯袭击学院时，乔治使用注射剂来保护女孩们，但几乎失去了控制。学生Yuuki Hikaru与Injel一起变身，展现出她的兼容性并击败了怪物。

乔治向光解释说，这些怪物与学院中的一系列绑架和袭击事件有关，目标是与引杰尔兼容的女孩。光对朋友的受害感到愤怒，决定以魔法少女的身份去战斗。无处可去的乔治被光和她的母亲明日香结城收留，开始了他们的同居生活并与涅墨西斯展开战斗。
